text:
Situation: Hydrocodone bitartrate and acetaminophen 10 mg tablets are not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 263 tablets (16.7 days), Corvale General holds 558 tablets (28.8 days), and Corvale Lakeside holds 59 tablets (12.4 days). Lakeside is below our 14-day target.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include this product as of 2026-10-21. A product label identifies Proficient Rx LP (FEI 3011557028) as a repack plant with a Voluntary Action Indicated inspection ending 2022-12-08.

Our position: Current inventory supports East and General for more than two weeks. Lakeside requires replenishment within two weeks. No national shortage is declared. Alternate manufacturers are available and not on FDA's shortage list.

Recommended actions:
1. Place orders for Lakeside from the ranked alternate manufacturers starting with Alvogen Inc. (needs: buyer approval).
2. Monitor daily usage at all three sites and update days-on-hand weekly (needs: pharmacy operations manager approval).
3. Report Lakeside inventory status to the P&T committee at the next scheduled meeting (needs: committee chair approval).

Not recommended: Initiate therapeutic substitutions or formulary changes based on supply; clinical decisions remain with treating clinicians and the committee.
